title: Kanda 17: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 17.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 17.

verses.original: विभ्राड् बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मधु सूर्यो रश्मिभिः पतगः सुवर्णः ।
verses.transliteration: vibhrāḍ bṛhatpibatu somyaṁ madhu sūryo raśmibhiḥ patagaḥ suvarṇaḥ |
verses.translation: May the splendid high Surya, the golden-winged bird of heaven, drink the sweet Soma and illumine our world with His rays!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The solar hymn invoking vitality, cosmic illumination, and boundless energy.

layers.author: whitney
layers.content: सायण भाष्य: May the splendid high Surya, the golden-winged bird of heaven, drink the sweet Soma and illumine our world with His rays!
